catalog_date_records.title: Homozygosity mapping with SNP arrays identifies TRIM32, an E3 ubiquitin ligase, as a Bardet-Biedl syndrome gene (BBS11). (2006)

missense mutations in TRIM32 are also associated with limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2H (LGMD2H)

catalog_date_records.title: Toll-like receptor 4 variant D299G is associated with susceptibility to age-related macular degeneration. (2005)

toll-like receptors recognize microorganisms and then initiate an immune response; TLR4 produces a widely-expressed transmembrane protein which recognizes lipopolysaccharide from Gram-negative bacteria; the Gly allele is protective against atherosclerosis

catalog_date_records.title: CRB2 mutation causes autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa. (2019)

catalog_date_records.title: Biallelic variants in coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis pathway genes cause a retinitis pigmentosa phenotype. (2022)

catalog_date_records.title: WDR34, a candidate gene for non-syndromic rod-cone dystrophy. (2021)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in EXOSC2 are associated with a novel syndrome characterised by retinitis pigmentosa, progressive hearing loss, premature ageing, short stature, mild intellectual disability and distinctive gestalt. (2016)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in TUBB4B Cause a Distinctive Sensorineural Disease. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: Refsum disease is caused by mutations in the phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase gene. (1997)

catalog_date_records.title: Identification of autosomal recessive novel genes and retinal phenotypes in members of the solute carrier (SLC) superfamily. (2022)

catalog_date_records.title: Biallelic variants in coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis pathway genes cause a retinitis pigmentosa phenotype. (2022)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation of CDH23, encoding a new member of the cadherin gene family, causes Usher syndrome type 1D. (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in PCDH21 cause autosomal recessive cone-rod dystrophy. (2010)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in KIF11 cause autosomal-dominant microcephaly variably associated with congenital lymphedema and chorioretinopathy. (2012)

RPE atrophy with night blindness and reduced visual acuity; carrier protein for serum retinol

catalog_date_records.title: Homozygosity mapping reveals PDE6C mutations in patients with early-onset cone photoreceptor disorders. (2009)

optic nerve colobomas with renal abnormalities; similar malformations in Pax2(1Neu) mouse mutation

catalog_date_records.title: Homozygous disruption of PDZD7 by reciprocal translocation in a consanguineous family: a new member of the Usher syndrome protein interactome causing congenital hearing impairment. (2009)

catalog_comments: homozygous chromosomal translocation breakpoint in the PDZK7 gene in an 8 year old child with hearing loss but no retinal disease; included as a likely Usher syndrome gene (not in Summaries)
gene interacts with DFNB31 and USH1C proteins; may modify other Usher mutations

catalog_date_records.title: De novo occurrence of a variant in ARL3 and apparent autosomal dominant transmission of retinitis pigmentosa. (2016)

catalog_comments: a de novo, damaging missense mutation in ARL3 segregates in two generations of two families with autosomal dominant RP; a 4-generation family with a different missense variant later identified; ADP-ribosylation factors are small GTPase enzymes

catalog_date_records.title: Exome sequencing of Bardet-Biedl syndrome patient identifies a null mutation in the BBSome subunit BBIP1 (BBS18). (2013)

catalog_date_records.title: A novel locus for autosomal dominant cone-rod dystrophy maps to chromosome 10q. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Hypothetical LOC387715 is a second major susceptibility gene for age-related macular degeneration contributing independently from complement factor H to disease risk. (2005)

catalog_date_records.title: Human HtrA, an evolutionarily conserved serine protease identified as a differentially expressed gene product in osteoarthritic cartilage. (1998)

many mutations reported

catalog_date_records.title: ZNF408 is mutated in familial exudative vitreoretinopathy and is crucial for the development of zebrafish retinal vasculature. (2013)

catalog_date_records.title: A homozygous mutation in the TUB gene associated with retinal dystrophy and obesity. (2013)

the TUB gene shares homology with the TULP1 gene causing recessive RP and LCA

catalog_date_records.title: A novel TEAD1 mutation is the causative allele in Sveinsson's chorioretinal atrophy (helicoid peripapillary chorioretinal degeneration). (2004)

catalog_date_records.title: A new locus for autosomal dominant familial exudative vitreoretinopathy maps to chromosome 11p12-13. (2001)

phenotypes: recessive microvillus inclusion disease with or without EOSRD

catalog_date_records.title: Pathogenic STX3 variants affecting the retinal and intestinal transcripts cause an early-onset severe retinal dystrophy in microvillus inclusion disease subjects. (2021)

catalog_comments: Biallelic STX3 variants were first reported in individuals with microvillus inclusion disease (MVID); additional studies of patients with a combination of MVID and an early-onset severe retinal dystrophy revealed a different set of causative mutations. catalog_date_records.title: Joubert syndrome 2 (JBTS2) in Ashkenazi Jews is associated with a TMEM216 mutation. (2010)

catalog_date_records.title: A missense mutation in ASRGL1 is involved in causing autosomal recessive retinal degeneration. (2016)

catalog_date_records.title: Localization of the photoreceptor gene ROM1 to human chromosome 11 and mouse chromosome 19: sublocalization to human 11q13 between PGA and PYGM. (1992)

catalog_date_records.title: Identification of the gene (BBS1) most commonly involved in Bardet-Biedl syndrome, a complex human obesity syndrome. (2002)

catalog_date_records.title: TMEM126A, encoding a mitochondrial protein, is mutated in autosomal-recessive nonsyndromic optic atrophy. (2009)

catalog_date_records.title: DYNC2H1 hypomorphic or retina-predominant variants cause nonsyndromic retinal degeneration. (2020)

catalog_date_records.title: Exome capture reveals ZNF423 and CEP164 mutations, linking renal ciliopathies to DNA damage response signaling. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: A new autosomal recessive syndrome consisting of posterior microphthalmos, retinitis pigmentosa, foveoschisis, and optic disc drusen is caused by a MFRP gene mutation. (2006)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation in the auxiliary calcium-channel subunit CACNA2D4 causes autosomal recessive cone dystrophy. (2006)

catalog_date_records.title: A nonsense mutation in PDE6H causes autosomal-recessive incomplete achromatopsia. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in the gene encoding 11-cis retinol dehydrogenase cause delayed dark adaptation and fundus albipunctatus. (1999)

catalog_date_records.title: Loss-of-function variants in SAXO6, encoding a microtubule inner protein of photoreceptor cilia, cause a late-onset retinal dystrophy. (2026)

catalog_date_records.title: CCT2 mutations evoke Leber congenital amaurosis due to chaperone complex instability. (2016)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in CEP290, which encodes a centrosomal protein, cause pleiotropic forms of Joubert syndrome. (2006)

catalog_date_records.title: Disruption of the basal body protein POC1B results in autosomal-recessive cone-rod dystrophy. (2014)

catalog_date_records.title: IFT81 as a candidate gene for nonsyndromic retinal degeneration. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: De novo and inherited dominant variants in U4 and U6 snRNA genes cause retinitis pigmentosa. (2026)

catalog_date_records.title: A homozygous mutation of C12orf65 causes spastic paraplegia with optic atrophy and neuropathy (SPG55). (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in VWA8 cause autosomal-dominant retinitis pigmentosa via aberrant mitophagy activation. (2023)

catalog_date_records.title: Bi-allelic variants in three genes encoding distinct subunits of the vesicular AP-5 complex cause hereditary macular dystrophy. (2025)

catalog_date_records.title: New syndrome with retinitis pigmentosa is caused by nonsense mutations in retinol dehydrogenase RDH11. (2014)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in RDH12 encoding a photoreceptor cell retinol dehydrogenase cause childhood-onset severe retinal dystrophy. (2004)

catalog_date_records.title: Biallelic variants in TTLL5, encoding a tubulin glutamylase, cause retinal dystrophy. (2014)

catalog_date_records.title: A mutation in IFT43 causes non-syndromic recessive retinal degeneration. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: A novel locus for Leber congenital amaurosis on chromosome 14q24. (1998)

catalog_date_records.title: Basal body dysfunction is a likely cause of pleiotropic Bardet-Biedl syndrome. (2003)

catalog_date_records.title: Missense variations in the fibulin 5 gene and age-related macular degeneration. (2004)

catalog_date_records.title: TRPM1 is mutated in patients with autosomal-recessive complete congenital stationary night blindness. (2009)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in TUBGCP4 alter microtubule organization via the γ-tubulin ring complex in autosomal-recessive microcephaly with chorioretinopathy. (2015)

catalog_date_records.title: USH1H, a novel locus for type I Usher syndrome, maps to chromosome 15q22-23. (2009)

catalog_date_records.title: Variants in UBAP1L lead to autosomal recessive rod-cone and cone-rod dystrophy. (2024)

catalog_date_records.title: A mutation in SLC24A1 implicated in autosomal-recessive congenital stationary night blindness. (2010)

catalog_date_records.title: De novo and inherited dominant variants in U4 and U6 snRNA genes cause retinitis pigmentosa. (2026)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation of a nuclear receptor gene, NR2E3, causes enhanced S cone syndrome, a disorder of retinal cell fate. (2000)

catalog_date_records.title: Identification of the gene that, when mutated, causes the human obesity syndrome BBS4. (2001)

autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa (non-syndromic), recessive Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in SCAPER cause autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa with intellectual disability. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: Whole-Exome Sequencing Identifies Biallelic IDH3A Variants as a Cause of Retinitis Pigmentosa Accompanied by Pseudocoloboma. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: Alterations of the CIB2 calcium- and integrin-binding protein cause Usher syndrome type 1J and nonsyndromic deafness DFNB48. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation of the gene encoding cellular retinaldehyde-binding protein in autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa. (1997)

catalog_date_records.title: Using next-generation sequencing for the diagnosis of rare disorders: a family with retinitis pigmentosa and skeletal abnormalities. (2011)

catalog_date_records.title: Mainzer-Saldino syndrome is a ciliopathy caused by IFT140 mutations. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Hypomorphic mutations identified in the candidate Leber congenital amaurosis gene CLUAP1. (2016)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in ABCC6 cause pseudoxanthoma elasticum. (2000)

Indian families

catalog_date_records.title: Isolation of a novel gene underlying Batten disease, CLN3. (1995)

catalog_date_records.title: Ceramide synthase TLCD3B is a novel gene associated with human recessive retinal dystrophy. (2021)

catalog_date_records.title: Exome capture reveals ZNF423 and CEP164 mutations, linking renal ciliopathies to DNA damage response signaling. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in the gene encoding the basal body protein RPGRIP1L, a nephrocystin-4 interactor, cause Joubert syndrome. (2007)

catalog_date_records.title: Positional cloning of a novel gene on chromosome 16q causing Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS2). (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in ARL2BP, encoding ADP-ribosylation-factor-like 2 binding protein, cause autosomal-recessive retinitis pigmentosa. (2013)

catalog_comments: unrelated homozygous mutations detected in two consanguineous families, Arab-Muslim and European, respectively; affected individuals have RP and variable additional findings consistent with cilia-associated diseases

catalog_date_records.title: Segregation of a mutation in CNGB1 encoding the beta-subunit of the rod cGMP-gated channel in a family with autosomal recessive retinitis pigmentosa. (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: A comprehensive WGS-based pipeline for the identification of new candidate genes in inherited retinal dystrophies.. (2022)

catalog_date_records.title: A clinically complex form of dominant optic atrophy (OPA8) maps on chromosome 16. (2011)

catalog_date_records.title: Hypotrichosis with juvenile macular dystrophy is caused by a mutation in CDH3, encoding P-cadherin. (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: A missense mutation in the splicing factor gene DHX38 is associated with early-onset retinitis pigmentosa with macular coloboma. (2014)

catalog_date_records.title: Identification of ADAMTS18 as a gene mutated in Knobloch syndrome. (2011)

catalog_date_records.title: A new phenotype of recessively inherited foveal hypoplasia and anterior segment dysgenesis maps to a locus on chromosome 16q23.2-24.2. (2004)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in the m-AAA proteases AFG3L2 and SPG7 are causing isolated dominant optic atrophy. (2020)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in the pre-mRNA splicing factor gene PRPC8 in autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa (RP13). (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: A novel locus for Leber congenital amaurosis (LCA4) with anterior keratoconus mapping to chromosome 17p13. (2000)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation in the PYK2-binding domain of PITPNM3 causes autosomal dominant cone dystrophy (CORD5) in two Swedish families. (2007)

catalog_date_records.title: HRG4 (UNC119) mutation found in cone-rod dystrophy causes retinal degeneration in a transgenic model. (2000)

catalog_date_records.title: Whole-exome sequencing identifies mutations in GPR179 leading to autosomal-recessive complete congenital stationary night blindness. (2012)

catalog_date_records.title: Hypomorphic mutations in syndromic encephalocele genes are associated with Bardet-Biedl syndrome. (2008)

catalog_date_records.title: Structural Variants Create New Topological-Associated Domains and Ectopic Retinal Enhancer-Gene Contact in Dominant Retinitis Pigmentosa. (2020)

catalog_date_records.title: Defects in RGS9 or its anchor protein R9AP in patients with slow photoreceptor deactivation. (2004)

catalog_date_records.title: A homozygous founder missense variant in arylsulfatase G abolishes its enzymatic activity causing atypical Usher syndrome in humans. (2018)

catalog_date_records.title: Usher syndrome type I G (USH1G) is caused by mutations in the gene encoding SANS, a protein that associates with the USH1C protein, harmonin. (2003)

catalog_date_records.title: Identical mutation in a novel retinal gene causes progressive rod-cone degeneration in dogs and retinitis pigmentosa in humans. (2006)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutation of human retinal fascin gene (FSCN2) causes autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa. (2001)

catalog_date_records.title: Autosomal-recessive early-onset retinitis pigmentosa caused by a mutation in PDE6G, the gene encoding the gamma subunit of rod cGMP phosphodiesterase. (2010)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in REEP6 cause autosomal-recessive retinitis pigmentosa. (2016)

catalog_date_records.title: Biallelic mutation of ARHGEF18, involved in the determination of epithelial apicobasal polarity, causes adult-onset retinal degeneration. (2017)

catalog_date_records.title: Mutations in PNPLA6 are linked to photoreceptor degeneration and various forms of childhood blindness. (2015)
